description: This file contains unit tests for the RandomDecoderTest class and related functions in the HTTP/2 test tools, focusing on decoding behavior, error handling, and enum corruption testing.

classes.name: RandomDecoderTestTest
classes.description: A test class derived from RandomDecoderTest to verify decoding behaviors and error handling in HTTP/2 decoding tests.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Overrides base method to start decoding, increments call count, and optionally calls a custom function.

methods.name: ResumeDecoding
methods.description: Overrides base method to resume decoding, increments call count, and optionally calls a custom function.

methods.name: StopDecodeOnDone
methods.description: Overrides base method to determine if decoding should stop when done, based on internal flags.
